senses.zh: 较少地，不那么（less likely 不太可能）
较少的，更少的（修饰名词：less time）
较少的量，较少的东西（eat less of…）

example.en: It is more spacious and less crowded.
example.zh: 它更宽敞，也没那么拥挤。

less.note: 口径：less 修饰形容词/副词/动词（less likely, care less, less often）标0；修饰名词（less time, less sugar）标1；作宾语或 less of（eat less of, nine grams less, spend less on）标2；less than + 数量表示「不到」（less than two miles, in less than a month, less than half）标3，pay less than the ticket price 这类普通比较按2；much less / still less（更不用说）标 P:much less；less and less 标 P；more or less、no less than、none the less 若出现标 P。

senses.zh: 比如说，大约（插入语：at, say, £3,500）
假设（句首 Say…：Say you lose your job）
发言权，决定权（have a say）

example.en: Zoo officials say the baby was born on Monday.
example.zh: 动物园官员说，这只幼崽是周一出生的。

say.note: 口径：人（含 author、experts、researchers、officials）说标0；文章/passage/报告/新闻/科学/消息「写着、表明」标1；插入语 say（比如说、大约）标2；let's say 标 P:let's say（含「就算…吧」）；that is to say 标 P；not to say、say hello、say no、have to say 按0；it goes without saying、to say nothing of、needless to say 若出现标 P。题干 What does the author say… 很多，属材料不是答题说明。

senses.zh: （be going to）将要，打算（表示将来）
变得，转为（going extinct；go from A to B）
现行的，现有的（the going rate）

example.en: He is going to visit a friend.
example.zh: 他打算去拜访一位朋友。

going.note: 口径：be going to do 一律标0（作语法义项，不标 P）；be going to + 地点 是「去」标1；go on（发生/继续/持续，含 what's going on）、go through（经历；逐一过一遍）、go off（爆炸；响起）、go against（违背）、go by（以…名字称呼）、go back to（追溯到）、go on sale 标 P；go to、go for a run、go on (a) holiday、go outdoors 标1；go + 形容词（going extinct）和 go from A to B（从A转到B）标2。

senses.zh: 当…的时候，在…期间；与此同时

example.en: The child had taken the keys to the family car while his teenage sister was napping.
example.zh: 孩子趁十几岁的姐姐打盹时，拿走了家里汽车的钥匙。

while.note: 口径：表时间/同时标0（while doing、while in/on…、while a student，以及补充另一件同时发生之事的「与此同时」，如 …, while reducing…）；两件并列事实对比（多为句中「, while」，也包括句首 While 引出的纯对比，如 While 70% used to…, now only half…）标1；句首 While 让步、可换成 although 且主句与之相反（While this may seem…, pink dolphins do exist）标2；a while / for a (little/short) while / take a while 标3。1 与 2 边界本身模糊，请按「能否换成 although 且主句转折」判断。

example.en: I often feel strange on my birthday.
example.zh: 我过生日时常常感觉怪怪的。

often.note: 口径：how often（多久一次、多频繁，含间接问句 consider how often…）标 P:how often；as is (so) often the case 标 P:as is often the case；every so often、more often than not 若出现标 P；too often、as often as、more/less often 按0。

example.en: They have already become our new friends.
example.zh: 他们已经成了我们的新朋友。

our.note: 口径：泛指「我们人类/大家的」（our health, our society）也标0；书名/栏目名中的 Our（Economic Possibilities for Our Grandchildren）意思透明，按0；含 one's 的习语（spin one's wheels 白费力气）标对应 P。

senses.zh: 工作，活儿（要做的事；职业）
上班；工作单位（go to work 去上班，at work 在上班）
努力（work toward/for 为…而努力）

example.en: He has been burdened with excessive work.
example.zh: 他被过多的工作压得喘不过气。

work.note: 口径：名词「工作、任务、活儿、职业」及作定语（work schedules, work experience, work colleagues, academic work, construction work）标0；动词工作/干活/共事（work with sb, work together, work from home, work hard/harder）标1；上班、在岗、工作单位（go/walk/commute/jog to work, at work, on my way to work, near to work, get back into work, bring cats to work）标2；起作用/行得通/好用（didn't work, work better, work both ways, bottles that work with tap water）标3；作品、研究成果（his work showed…, posted his work online）标4；work toward(s)/for + 目标 标5；out of work、work out、work on（修理；致力于）、work through（处理、解决）、body of work、work-study（勤工助学）标 P。
